q1_issues.issue: the noun-complement oblique (For language sk_spread_1) is hung on the subject kind rather than on the "vehicle" predicate nominal it actually modifies, so the parse asserts that language as such is for spreading racist ideology instead of restricting the vehicle class the sentence predicates of it.

q2_gaps: "one of the most ADJ Ns" -- a non-unique / top-tier superlative: Most encodes a unique maximum only, so the three coordinated superlative adjectives ("most systematic, subtle, and significant") have no licensed carrier and are dropped entirely

an argument PP on a PREDICATE NOMINAL in a copular kind clause ("X is a vehicle for V-ing"): the copular collapses to (Inheritance X vehicle), leaving no noun symbol for the prescribed (For <noun-symbol> <argument>) form to attach to
notes: The instruction set says the For-argument's eventuality is "asserted nowhere", yet the spread event's class and role atoms sit at top level at (STV 1.0 0.99); they carry no tense, which matches the occurrence-neutral convention used for non-finite complements, so the requirement is ambiguous rather than plainly violated. Fusing racist_ideology with both a genus and an exposed adjectival modifier is licensed (racist is predicable of the ideology).
